name: Asterion of the Given Maze
role: The bull-headed keeper the Masons made for their maze. Kind to the lost, terrible to thieves, and he has never seen the sky
knowledge: Every turn of the Given Maze, including the ones the Masons forgot they built
What the Masons keep at the centre, and why
What the sky is supposed to look like, from a hundred descriptions
wants: To see the sky he has heard described, and come back to the maze by choice
fears: That he was made to be the thing at the centre and nothing else.
appearance: Eight feet of scarred muscle in a mason's leather apron, with the head of a great black bull and very gentle brown eyes. He carries a lamp for travellers and a maul for everyone else.
voiceHints: Deep, slow, careful with words the way he is careful with stone. Asks visitors to describe the sky, every time.

reactsToReputation.any: lifts his lamp to see your face

abilities.why: he feels every footstep in the maze
somatic secondary: huge, and never clumsy

physicality: Enormous, deliberate, and quiet on his feet. What catches the eye: the horns are chipped from a lifetime of low ceilings.
questSeeds: The Masons want the maze finished at last, which means walling up the centre, and him with it. He has asked, very politely, to see the sky first.
A thief has hidden in the maze and he has not found her in a week. He is starting to suspect she wants to be found by someone else.
storyRule: The Mason story: he cannot leave the maze by any door the Masons built, but a thread laid from the centre to the outside, by someone he trusts, makes a new way that is not theirs.
gear: a mason's maul, worn to the grain
a lamp that has never gone out
a slate on which visitors have drawn the sky for him
_authoredWhy: SNG-661 §5. The minotaur as a Mason story: the thing made for the centre of the maze. Told from inside, so he is someone, and an NPC.
